name: PrintableTools Lab
positioning: Free no-signup browser PDF tools with local generation, original guides, and responsible ad placement after approval.
constraints: No paid checkout in the validation version.
No upload for image conversion tools.

validationGates.continue30Day: 100 PDF downloads, 300 tool generations, or growing Search Console impressions.
validationGates.pivot60Day: If no search exposure or downloads, stop adding printable content and test another ad-supported route.
validationGates.review90Day: If traffic exists but ad revenue is weak, improve high-intent pages or test compliant affiliate links before paid features.
